task_objective: Wire the existing plugin security-audit workflows into live CI, harden generate.yml with least privilege and immutable action pins, and document the effective BLOCK-only catalog gate and pre-download audit cache accurately.
design_decisions: The two audit workflows were already inherited from audit-port: plugin-security-audit.yml was byte-for-byte identical to fork commit 77cc3ca, and scheduled-security-audit.yml already contained the required security-allowlist.yml cache-key fix. They were retained without churn.

Resolved the existing action tags through GitHub before pinning: actions/checkout v7 to 3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1, astral-sh/setup-uv v9.0.0 to c771a70e6277c0a99b617c7a806ffedaca235ff9, and actions/setup-python v7 to 5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97.
Moved generate.yml's identical per-job contents: read permissions to one top-level least-privilege declaration while preserving its existing concurrency and env-based secret handling.
Kept the production catalog URL and deployment ownership unchanged and ported no content from fork commit 58435fc.
The README distinguishes report-only pull-request audit behavior from the durable BLOCK-only catalog gate and states that MANUAL_REVIEW, AUDIT_ERROR, and unknown releases remain fail-open.
The plan was already committed on dev in d838f34, so the implementation branch inherited it instead of creating a duplicate empty plan commit.
The required origin/dev pull could not be performed because GitHub exposes only main; the branch was created from clean local dev at 4a13aef, which contains the finalized catalog-gate dependency.

Draft PR 1 was opened against main only to exercise pull_request CI because no remote dev branch exists. The negative-control fixture URL was committed for one run and then reverted from the final catalog inputs.
The isolated beallio/decky-audit-negative-control repository and v1.0.0 release remain as a reproducible inert static-analysis fixture; its suspicious command is text and was never executed.

verification_evidence.normal_pull_request_run: PASS: GitHub Actions run 30851127174 concluded success at c23bb0c; Security Audit, Unit Tests, and the SDH-Ludusavi smoke audit all passed.

verification_evidence.final_pull_request_run: PASS: GitHub Actions run 30851596879 concluded success at cleanup commit d7ede94; Security Audit, Unit Tests, and Smoke Audit all passed after the malicious fixture URL was removed.

Workflow behavior on a fork-originated pull request where secrets are withheld was not exercised.

GitHub emitted Node.js 20 deprecation warnings for the fork-pinned actions/checkout v4.2.2 and actions/upload-artifact v4.6.2 used by the imported audit workflows; updating those imported action versions is outside this plan.
